cards.audioText: Would you like to visit some duty-free shops at airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢去机场的免税店吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, when the flight schedule is not very tight, I would like to visit duty-free shops which selling a large selection of tax-free goods with local characteristic, and buy some real bargains.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当航班日程不是很紧时我喜欢逛免税店，店内会有大量带有当地特色的免税商品，我可以买到物美价廉的商品。

cards.audioText: Do you have any plan about your future?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对你的未来有什么计划吗？
cards.referenceText: Since I am a student pilot and I fly C172 now, so I hope I can become a qualified pilot and join Air China and fly B787 in the future.
cards.referenceTextZh: 因为我现在还是一名飞行学员，飞的是塞斯纳172，所以我希望变成合格的飞行员，在未来可以加入国航飞波音787。

cards.audioText: What problems you may have when being abroad?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在国外时会遇到什么样的问题？
cards.referenceText: I am afraid the language barrier will come first, and another problem is that I’m not used to foreign food.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先要考虑的就是语言障碍，另一个问题就是我不习惯国外的食物。

cards.audioText: What are you going to do right after this test?
cards.audioTextZh: 这次考试结束后，你会干什么？
cards.referenceText: Maybe I will have a good rest, because I have prepared for this test for a long time and I feel a little bit tired.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我可能会好好休息下，因为我已经为这次考试准备了很久，感觉有一点点累，

cards.audioText: Which do you like better, in-flight meal or home cooking?
cards.audioTextZh: 你更喜欢飞机餐还是家常菜？
cards.referenceText: I prefer home cooking. Airline menus are often high in energy, fat and sodium, and I could not consume as much energy as the meals offer. Apart from that, being a pilot, flying in the sky most time, I prefer the feeling at home.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我更喜欢家常菜。通常飞机餐的能量、脂肪和钠较高，我无法消耗飞机餐提供的能量。此外，作为飞行员，大部分时间都在空中飞行，我更喜欢在家的感觉。

cards.audioText: Do you know anything about C919?
cards.audioTextZh: 你了解C919吗？
cards.referenceText: It is designed by Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China (COMAC), and it’s the first big jet that we design and produce in our country. I’m so proud that China has its own big aircraft now.
cards.referenceTextZh: C919是中国商飞设计的，它是中国自己设计和生产的第一款大飞机，对于中国能有自己的大飞机，我感到非常自豪。

cards.audioText: Which season do you prefer? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪个季节？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I prefer autumn because it is a beautiful and comfortable season. It is not too hot or too cold and the scenery is pretty good in autumn. In addition, it is a good season for travel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢秋季，因为秋季是个优美宜人的季节。秋季的天气既不太热也不太冷，并且景色很美。此外秋季还是旅行的好季节。

cards.audioText: What’s the difference between C919 and other big jet?
cards.audioTextZh: C919和其他大飞机有哪些不同？
cards.referenceText: C919 is another step in the development of Chinese technology, marking that China’s big jet can enter the world’s advanced level. There are many advanced functions in C919, it has low noise, it is fuel saving, and passengers will feel more comfortable on board, but compared with Boeing and Airbus, it has lower passenger capacity.
cards.referenceTextZh: C919是中国科技进步的又一次提升，标志着中国大飞机制造进入到世界先进水平行列。目前C919有很多先进的功能，比如低噪音、省燃油，乘客有更舒适的乘机体验，但相较于波音和空客，它的载客量较低。

cards.audioText: Where did you fly to on your last flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最近一次飞行是去哪里？
cards.referenceText: My last flight was from Sydney to Beijing, and then I had two days off. / My last flight was from Guangzhou to Shanghai. Because I have to take the test today, so my leader arranged me to fly a short flight in order to get much time to prepare.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最近的飞行是从悉尼飞到北京，然后我有两天的休假。/ 我最近一次飞行是从广州到上海，因为我今天要参加考试，所以我的领导为我安排短程航班，这样我会有更多的时间来准备考试。

cards.audioText: Do you have any outlook about China’s aviation in the next decade?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对中国航空未来十年发展有何展望？
cards.referenceText: The future must be bright, and I hope our own aircraft will be better and better.
cards.referenceTextZh: 前景一定是好的，我相信我们自己的大飞机也一定会越来越好。

cards.audioText: Do you want to work in foreign airlines?
cards.audioTextZh: 你想在外航工作吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I do. I think working in foreign airlines not only pays better, but also let me experience different cultures. It's a very interesting thing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我想。我觉得在外航工作不仅收入更高，而且可以体验不同国家的文化。这是一件很有意思的事情。

cards.audioText: Do you ever feel overworked?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾有过度劳累的情况吗？
cards.referenceText: Most of the flying time is arranged and limited, so I don’t feel overworked normally, unless I meet abnormal weather conditions, under which I always feel exhausted, because we may wait a long time for taking off or landing, or we may divert to other airports.
cards.referenceTextZh: 大部分的飞行时间是有限并安排好的，所以通常我不会感到劳累过度。除非遇到反常的天气情况，这时我会感到疲惫，因为起飞或着陆需要等待很长时间，有时还需要转飞到其它机场。

cards.audioText: In your opinion, what are the challenges of working in a foreign airline?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你看来，在外航工作有哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: I think the biggest challenge lies in language and culture. Therefore, we need to improve our English.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为最大的挑战在于语言和文化这一方面。因此，我们需要提高自己的英语水平。

cards.audioText: Do you like your leader to contact you after work hours? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢领导在下班后联系你吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Frankly speaking, I don’t like to be contacted during my breaks. I want to enjoy the after-work time, but if there are important things, it depends.
cards.referenceTextZh: 坦白说，我不喜欢别人在休息时间联系我。我希望能享受休息的时间，但如果有重要的事情我会看情况而定。

cards.audioText: What's your company’s logo?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们公司的logo是什么？
cards.referenceText: Our company is China Eastern Airlines. Its logo is a swallow. In ancient times, swallows were called auspicious birds, symbolizing luck and harmony.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们公司是东方航空，它的logo是一只燕子，在古代，燕子被称为吉鸟，象征吉祥与和顺。

cards.audioText: When is your next simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你什么时候参加下次模拟训练？
cards.referenceText: I just finished my simulator training last month, and we have simulator training twice every year, so the next one will be in five months.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上个月我刚结束模拟训练，我们每年训练两次，下次训练会在五个月内。

cards.audioText: Do you know which domestic airlines operate the C919?
cards.audioTextZh: 您知道哪些国内航空公司运营 C919 客机吗？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, there are many airlines operating the C919 domestically, such as Air China, China Eastern Airlines and China Southern Airlines.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知，国内运营C919 的航司有很多，比如，国航、东航、南航。

cards.audioText: Tell me about a great change that occurred in your life.
cards.audioTextZh: 讲讲你生活中发生的大改变。
cards.referenceText: Honestly I haven’t thought about this much, but the topic reminds me of my beginning of the flying career. I was selected from a key university to the Flight College, which changed my whole life and made my childhood dream come true.
cards.referenceTextZh: 说实话对此我没想过太多，但这个话题让我想起了飞行事业刚开始的阶段。我从一所重点大学被选拔到飞行学院，这改变了我整个人生，实现了我童年时的梦想。

cards.audioText: Do you have any international flights coming up?
cards.audioTextZh: 接下来你还有国际飞行任务么？
cards.referenceText: Yes. After taking this exam, I’m flying to Singapore tomorrow morning.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有。考试结束后，明天我要飞新加坡。

cards.audioText: Have you experienced any awkward things in your life?
cards.audioTextZh: 你人生中遇到过尴尬的事么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, there are several funny stories in my life. The most awkward experience in my memory is that once I went into Lady’s room and I didn’t realize it until I came out.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到过，我有许多有趣的经历。印象中最尴尬的是有一次去厕所，出来之后才意识到我错进了女厕所。

cards.audioText: Which country do you like to visit most in the world?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最想去哪个国家旅行？
cards.referenceText: I would like to visit Egypt, which is one of the four civilized ancient countries in the world just like China. It is a famous tourist resort with its fabulous natural environment and attractive customs which will actually relax me.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我想去埃及，和中国一样，埃及是四大文明古国之一。埃及是著名的旅游胜地，有着极好的自然环境和吸引人的风俗文化，在那里我可以放松身心。

cards.audioText: Do you have flight tomorrow?
cards.audioTextZh: 你明天有航班要飞么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I’ll fly to America.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有，我要飞美国。

cards.audioText: Tell me about your favorite airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 请介绍一下你最喜欢的机场。
cards.referenceText: My favorite airport is Beijing Capital International Airport. It has the best emergency service in China. Because Beijing is the capital of China and Beijing Airport has the largest traffic volume in China, thus the government pays a great attention to the safety of Beijing Airport, and the best facilities are equipped in Beijing Airport. There are also a special public police team to deal with terrorist activity. Only better emergency service can make sure the safe operation of all aircraft coming in and out of the airport, particularly during the 2008 Olympic Games.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的机场是北京首都国际机场，那里有中国机场最好的紧急服务。因为北京是中国的首都，首都机场有全国最大的交通量，因此政府很重视首都机场的安全，机场配备了最好的设备，同时机场内有应对恐怖活动的公共特警队。只有更好的紧急服务才能保证所有飞机安全地进出场，尤其是2008年奥运会期间。

cards.audioText: Tell me about the different approaches you can fly.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉我你会哪些进近方式。
cards.referenceText: I can fly ILS or LOC approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会盲降和LOC进近。

cards.audioText: What are your ambitions in life?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的追求是什么？
cards.referenceText: When I was young, my ambitions were to have a happy family and a desirable career, and both were fulfilled. Now, my ambitions in life are to make a good salary to support my family and keep physical and mental health every day.
cards.referenceTextZh: 年轻的时候，我希望能有一个幸福的家庭和一份理想的职业，这些都已经实现了。现在，我对生活的追求是用一份可观的收入养家，保持身体健康和好心情。

cards.audioText: When did you start flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 你何时开始飞行的？
cards.referenceText: I started flying in 2004.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我从2004年开始飞行。

cards.audioText: How do you see online shopping?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何看待网上购物？
cards.referenceText: Online shopping is very popular nowadays. I think we pilots can benefit a lot from it, because we usually have no time to go shopping outside. Online shopping makes it easy and convenient to shop because we can buy whatever we need without going outside.
cards.referenceTextZh: 现在很流行网上购物，我认为网上购物为飞行员提供了便捷，因为我们通常没时间出门购物，网上购物使购物变得简洁、方便，我们不出门就可以购物。

cards.audioText: What have you learnt being a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 成为飞行员后你学到了些什么？
cards.referenceText: The most important thing I have learnt is being calm under any emergency situation. I must believe in myself during emergency and make decisions timely and correctly. On the base of that, it could be possible to overcome difficulties.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我学到的最重要的事就是在遇到紧急情况时保持镇定。我必须相信自己，及时作出正确的决定。只有这样，才可以克服困难。

cards.audioText: What is the importance of communication in daily life?
cards.audioTextZh: 交流在日常生活中的重要性是什么？
cards.referenceText: Communication is the mode of transferring information from one person to another. It is an essential skill for successful business and personal relationships. Effective communication is a must at work and in daily life.
cards.referenceTextZh: 交流是人与人之间传递信息的方式。交流是商务和人际关系中的重要技能。高效的交流在工作和生活中都是非常重要的。

cards.audioText: Will you have a vacation recently?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最近有假期吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, next week I will have a five days vacation with my wife. / No, being a pilot means rare vacation time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下周我有五天假期，我会和妻子一起度假。/ 没有，飞行员的假期很少。
